title: Flix Structurally-Unattachable Kind Evidence Schema
description: Schema for ast/unattachable.json, the one hand-maintained input to ast/status.json. An entry asserts that a TreeKind or TokenKind cannot appear in any projected tree from any input -- a fact about the reference parser, not about this suite's fixtures -- and must carry the source citations that establish it. Because 'not observed in the corpus' and 'cannot be observed at all' are different claims, a kind may only be reported as structurally-unattachable if it appears here.

upstreamCommit.description: flix/flix commit every citation below was read against. Asserted against pin.json, so a pin bump fails until the evidence is re-verified rather than silently carrying stale line numbers.

note.description: Free-text maintenance note explaining the file's contract to a human editor.

treeKinds.description: Entries whose name must exist in ast/treekind.json.

tokenKinds.description: Entries whose name must exist in ast/tokenkind.json.

name.description: Kind name, matching the corresponding inventory exactly.

reason.description: Why the kind cannot be attached: an ordering argument, a dead-store argument, or absence from main/src. Long enough to force an argument rather than an assertion.

items.description: Upstream-relative path and line, read at upstreamCommit.

citations.description: May be empty only when the reason is that no reference exists anywhere in main/src -- there is no line to cite for an absence.
